sourceDocuments.title: Deep Learning for Yoruba Named Entity Recognition
sourceDocuments.text: Diacritic restoration using bidirectional long short-term memory recurrent neural networks improves acoustic phonetic accuracy in tonal language automatic speech recognition.

studentDocument.text: Igbo verbal morphology involves extensive prefixation, suffixation, and interfixation to express grammatical aspect, requiring finite-state transducers for computational lexicon parsing.
